{{Top|leg}}
'''Gardener''' was a type of scientific profession. The [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Reiva Carrick]]<ref name="KotOR2">[[Knights of the Old Republic 2|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 2]]</ref> and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Kardeer]] were both gardeners.<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] employed a [[Palpatine's gardener|gardener]].<ref name="SofE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> A [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Unidentified Ho'Din gardener|gardener]] also worked for [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]].<ref name="E1A7:CA">''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]'' ([[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne|Game Book]])</ref>
